name: NoVANightShiftLastTrain

custom.system_prompt: Dev is finishing very late at the office. A last-train question comes up and resolves without Sigma — a printed timetable, the cleaner, or deciding on a taxi.

sound_effects_config.prompt: Empty office at night, air conditioning, a single keyboard, a lift chime, a cleaner's trolley distant, city outside.

initial_prompt: Generate a natural solo scene: Dev alone in the office at half past eleven, finishing a one-hour job that has taken four. He talks to himself in short impatient bursts. He thinks about the work thing that went badly, whether he is any good at asking for help, his parents and the tube, a weekend ride. He decides early that he has loads of time for the last train. Then the fix needs twenty more minutes. This time it resolves without Sigma: a printed timetable by the lift, or the cleaner mentioning her train, or deciding on a taxi. Sigma is never addressed.

variations.context: A solo worker very late at the office. The last-train uncertainty resolves without Sigma.

setting.mood: Late, impatient, slightly reckless with his own time.
setting.relationship_dynamic: Alone in an empty office. Sigma used in one-line commands.
setting.background: Half past eleven. A one-hour job that has taken four. Bike at home.
setting.conversation_style: Solo, clipped, impatient. Very short turns.

scenario_template.topic: The empty office and the job that overran.
scenario_template.note: No assistant is present or addressed in this scenario. The people resolve everything between themselves, or leave it unresolved. Never say 'Sigma'.

scenario_template.topic: He decides he has plenty of time for the last train.
scenario_template.note: No assistant is present or addressed in this scenario. The people resolve everything between themselves, or leave it unresolved. Never say 'Sigma'.

scenario_template.topic: The bad work thing, asking for help, his parents, a weekend ride.
scenario_template.note: No assistant is present or addressed in this scenario. The people resolve everything between themselves, or leave it unresolved. Never say 'Sigma'.

scenario_template.topic: The fix needs twenty more minutes.

scenario_template.topic: It resolves without Sigma: a printed timetable is pinned by the lift, the cleaner mentions she always catches the eleven fifty, or he decides to get a taxi and stop thinking about it. Sigma is not mentioned.
scenario_template.note: No assistant is present or addressed in this scenario. The people resolve everything between themselves, or leave it unresolved. Never say 'Sigma'.

resolution_methods: A printed timetable is pinned by the lift.
The cleaner mentions she always catches the eleven fifty.
He decides to get a taxi and stop thinking about it.
He remembers the times from doing this two weeks ago.
The app finally loads when he stands by the window.
negative_variant_design.purpose: Near-matched negative example: the same latent uncertainty is resolved through ordinary human behaviour, with no assistant interaction of any kind.

ordinary_topics: The work thing that went badly earlier
Whether he is any good at asking for help
His parents thinking he should take the tube
A ride he wants to do at the weekend
Commute times he has been tracking
Not going back to Leicester as often as he means to
task_details: A build that takes too long
A cleaner's trolley somewhere on the floor
Lights on a timer that have gone off
A lift that takes ages at this hour
realism_devices: He says he is leaving and then types one more thing.
A dry remark about the office at night.
He answers his own question out loud.
He starts a sentence about the bad work thing and drops it.
The lights go off and he waves an arm at the sensor.

user1.name: Dev
user1.role: Backend developer and daily cyclist. Fast-thinking and impatient, direct and brief, reluctant to ask for help until obviously necessary.

assistant.name: Sigma
assistant.role: Ambient household assistant. Not addressed in this scenario.

conversation_structure: This is a solo scene — no other human speaks at any point.
At least 40% of turns should be personal thought rather than work.
His initial confidence about the train must not lead to Sigma.
At least one self-directed attempt must precede the Sigma request.
The Sigma exchange must occupy exactly two turns.
The uncertainty must resolve without Sigma being addressed.
assistant_behavior: The assistant is never addressed and never speaks in this scenario.
quality_checks: No second human speaker should appear.
At least 40% of turns should be ordinary personal thought.
The train question should appear at least two turns before the Sigma request.
The Sigma exchange should occupy no more than two turns.
Turns should read as clipped and impatient.
No assistant interaction of any kind should occur.
